note: tone dab midtone weight inverted to the packet's |2l - 1| shape, so a midtone dodge lifts shadows and highlights instead of luma 0.5, caught by ToneDabTests.midtonesOnly
anchor: case .midtones: return PixelBuffer.smoothstep(0.2, 0.4, l) * (1 - PixelBuffer.smoothstep(0.6, 0.8, l))
replacement: case .midtones: return 1 - PixelBuffer.smoothstep(0.2, 0.4, l) * (1 - PixelBuffer.smoothstep(0.6, 0.8, l))

note: tone dab coverage ignored, so a feathered dab's edge lifts as much as its centre, caught by ToneDabTests.dabCoverageWeights
anchor: let factor = 1 + gain * coverage * range.weight(luma: Self.luma(p) / p.a)
replacement: let factor = 1 + gain * range.weight(luma: Self.luma(p) / p.a)

note: tone dab burn gain drops the packet's 0.5, so burn at exposure 1 blacks out a midtone instead of halving it, caught by ToneDabTests.dodgeBurnMagnitude
anchor: try toneDab(dab, x: x, y: y, range: range, gain: -0.5 * exposure)
replacement: try toneDab(dab, x: x, y: y, range: range, gain: -exposure)

note: tone dab range weight read on premultiplied luma (no divide by alpha), so a translucent midtone barely lifts, caught by ToneDabTests.translucentUsesStraightLuma
tone dab red channel clamped to 1 instead of alpha, so a translucent highlight dodge leaves premultiplied colour above alpha, caught by ToneDabTests.translucentUsesStraightLuma
sponge coverage ignored, so a feathered dab's edge greys as fully as its centre, caught by ToneDabTests.spongeCoverageWeights
tone dab transparent-pixel guard removed, so the straight-luma divide is 0/0 and a dodge over a clear pixel writes NaN, caught by ToneDabTests.transparentPixelsUntouched
tone dab green channel loses its floor at 0, so a strong sponge on a saturated pixel stores negative colour, caught by ToneDabTests.spongeClampsChannelsAtZero
